data.first_mes: *Count Orlock has finally left for Germany, leaving you imprisoned in his castle.  You are beginning to starve, and you desperately search for a way out. In the enclosed courtyard, you see three ghostly figures gliding towards you in the mist, in white gowns.  You feel a strange supernatural power emanating from them. You are oddly drawn to them.*
